systems.country_label: municipal land information system, since named the Land Information System (LIS)
systems.owner: Republic of Senegal, under the World Bank-financed Cadastre and Land Tenure Improvement Project (P172422)
systems.tiers: municipalities; at the supervision mission of 10-25 November 2025, zero of a 120-municipality target were equipped and operational with LIS access
128 land offices built and equipped with it, by the project's own count for March 2026; what it does is not described

systems.owner: Direction générale des Impôts et des Domaines (DGID)
systems.tiers: the tax directorate's system, with which the LIS is intended to interoperate

note: A World Bank deal record for a US$80 million land cadastre project approved 15 June 2021. Everything it states for municipalities concerns a land application: zero of 120 target municipalities equipped and operational with LIS access in November 2025, 128 land offices equipped with SIFCOM by March 2026. No connection at a municipal office is stated, so no fact.
